mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs (external_id, workspace_uuid, type, status, payload) VALUES ( CONCAT('job_', REPLACE(CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS text), '-', '')), #{workspaceUUID}, 'webhook_delivery', 'pending', CAST(#{payload,sensitive=true} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select: WITH next_jobs AS ( SELECT uuid FROM jobs WHERE type = 'webhook_delivery' AND run_after <= NOW() AND ( status IN ('pending', 'retry') OR (status = 'running' AND locked_until < NOW()) ) ORDER BY run_after, created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), updated_jobs AS ( UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', locked_by = #{claimToken}, locked_until = NOW() + #{leaseMicroseconds} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond', updated_at = NOW() FROM next_jobs WHERE j.uuid = next_jobs.uuid RETURNING j.uuid, j.external_id, j.workspace_uuid, j.payload, j.attempts, j.locked_by ) SELECT u.uuid, u.external_id, u.workspace_uuid, u.locked_by, COALESCE(u.payload->'event', CAST('{}' AS jsonb)) AS event, u.attempts, NULLIF(u.payload->>'webhook_endpoint_uuid', '') AS webhook_endpoint_uuid, we.external_id AS webhook_endpoint_external_id, we.url AS webhook_endpoint_url, we.signing_secret AS webhook_endpoint_secret, we.status AS webhook_endpoint_status FROM updated_jobs u LEFT JOIN webhook_endpoints we ON we.uuid = CAST(NULLIF(u.payload->>'webhook_endpoint_uuid', '') AS uuid) AND we.workspace_uuid = u.workspace_uuid AND we.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{jobUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND locked_by = #{claimToken} AND status = 'running' AND locked_until > clock_timestamp() AND type = 'webhook_delivery'

UPDATE jobs SET status = 'failed', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{jobUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND locked_by = #{claimToken} AND status = 'running' AND locked_until > clock_timestamp() AND type = 'webhook_delivery'

UPDATE jobs SET status = #{params.Status}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, run_after = #{params.RunAfter}, updated_at = NOW(), attempts = #{params.Attempts}, payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('last_error', CAST(#{params.Reason,sensitive=true} AS text)) WHERE uuid = #{params.JobUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND locked_by = #{params.ClaimToken} AND status = 'running' AND locked_until > clock_timestamp() AND type = 'webhook_delivery'
